\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dC}\left[a\operatorname{Ei}(-a/C)\right]

\partial_{C_{i+1}}\Delta\Phi
&=\frac12 f_a'(\overline C_i)\Delta C+f_a(\overline C_i),\\

\end{aligned}
